solid.name: Solid Color
solid.description: A single color across your whole setup, with optional breathing.
screen.name: Screen Ambience
screen.description: The LEDs follow what is on the monitor: each light copies the color of the screen region in the same position. It can also follow the PC music: colors, brightness and motion change with the emotion of the music (sadness or joy, calm or aggression).
asus.LightingMode.hint: Effect: follows the active effect. Fixed: uses the color below.
asus.shutdownMode.hint: What the board shows after Hydraflow closes. It's saved on the board (also applies when you turn the PC back on).
wooting.restoreOnExit: When closing, go back to the keyboard's own lighting
screen.reactBrightness.hint: LED brightness while they follow the music: raises and lowers everything, pulses included.
screen.biasValence.hint: Shifts the reading toward sad (negative) or happy (positive).
screen.biasEnergy.hint: Shifts the reading toward calm (negative) or anger (positive).
screen.pulseIntensity.hint: How much the brightness rises on each beat, relative to the base brightness. Higher = stronger peak; lower = subtler change. Doesn't change the pulse's speed, length or rhythm.
